messages:
raj_acme: hey support — since yesterday evening (~17:40 UTC) our webhook parser started failing. Some completions returned invalid JSON; our parser throws `JSONDecodeError`. example request id=req_9a2c, response header showed rwd-7b-q8a. Blocking for our ingestion pipeline.

jess: can you paste raw request + response and the response headers? also what model did you ask for in the request?

raj_acme: here you go — request body we send:
```
POST /v1/completions
{
  "model": "rwd-7b-v2",
  "mode": "structured_json",
  "input": "Summarize the issue",
  "schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"issue":{"type":"string"}}}
}
```

and the raw http response (truncated):
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-redwood-model: rwd-7b-q8a
x-request-id: req_9a2c
{
  "result": {
    "issue": "User sees crash on save"
  }
}
```
Our parser expected the top-level `issue` field but got a `result` wrapper — so our schema-based extractor fails.

ops-bot: autoscaler: pool reserved-deg-3 at 90% load; smart-routing routing_policy=cost_first; fallback -> rwd-7b-q8a

tilly: this looks like smart-routing fell back to the q8a quantized variant. q8a predates the structured_json_v2 output contract and returns a `result` wrapper. Short-term fix: pin the customer's route to a variant advertising `structured_json_v2`. Long-term: runtime should enforce schema-preserving fallbacks (either rewrite wrappers on fallback or refuse to fallback when strict schema requested). Need repro steps + request/response headers.

sam: I reproduced by forcing a variant override. repro:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Model-Override: rwd-7b-q8a" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-7b-v2","mode":"structured_json","input":"Summarize","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"issue":{"type":"string"}}}}'
```
output:
```
{"result":{"issue":"User sees crash on save"}}
```
parse fails because extractor expected `{"issue":...}` at top-level.

jess: escalating to eng-runtime (P1 for this customer). assigning to @tilly and @sam. Temporary mitigations: 1) pin variant `rwd-7b-v2` for the customer's route in Console; 2) add header `X-Redwood-Strict-JSON: true` to reject fallbacks instead of accepting them. I'll apply the pin now.

tilly: I'll open a hotfix to add a capability check in smart-routing: do not fallback to variants unless they advertise `capabilities.structured_json_v2=true` when request has `mode=structured_json` or includes a schema. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4421. Rolling hotfix now; ETA ~4h. Full policy change in next deploy.

raj_acme: thanks — pin in place made errors stop. Please confirm when the hotfix is live and whether we get a changelog entry for fallback behavior.

jess: pinned and customer updated. Workaround documented in support KB. Will follow up with timeline and link to KB.

tilly: hotfix rolling; initial telemetry shows fallback rate down. We'll also add an observability alert for response-shape mismatches (schema mismatch rate > 0.1%). cc @sam.

raj_acme: confirmed client stable. thanks for the quick turnaround.

jess: keeping ticket open until prod rollout complete. ticket: SUP-2026-1184.
